records.title: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler [1987] EWCA Civ 2
records.creator: Court of Appeal (Civil Division), England and Wales
records.description: Published text of the Court of Appeal judgment concerning possession and adverse possession of Great House Farm, with the appeal limited to the farmhouse and garden. This is a public legal transcription, not the original sealed court file. The judgment recounts earlier events as part of its reasons; those passages should not be counted as independent corroboration of the underlying historical documents.

acquisition.retrieval_note: Located through a web search and read in part in this work session; full line-by-line citation audit remains outstanding.

limitations: A court judgment is an authoritative source for what the court decided and the reasoning it published; it is not an independent original source for every earlier event recounted in the judgment.
The appeal was limited to the farmhouse and garden; the judgment states that the possession order for the rest of the farm was not challenged on appeal.
This source does not, by itself, determine whether wider institutional coordination, fraud, deliberate concealment, or planning/heritage maladministration occurred.
